input_law: uniform among the 42 nonidentity E(F47) source points; finite coverage census rather than sampled targets
enumeration: canonical x=a/b^2 with gcd(abs(a),b)=1, b>=1, max(abs(a),b)<=H; test the integral quadratic discriminant for a rational y=c/b^3; include both rational y solutions
reduction_rule: retain rational points with b not divisible by 47; count b divisible by 47 separately as reduction-to-infinity cases
measurement: exact candidate discriminant tests, rational points, distinct finite reductions, uniform target coverage at each H; no wall-time comparison
claim_boundary: bounded search coverage for one fixed curve and enumeration; it is not a general lower bound for rational lifting
